newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Nov monthly inflation rises to 5.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania Nov monthly inflation rises to 5.8 pct.

text.p: Romania's monthly inflation quickened to 5.8 percent in November from 3.4 percent in October, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Monday.
Year-on-year inflation rose to 47.4 percent last month from October's 45.1 percent.
January-November consumer price inflation was 42.2 percent.

The IMF chief negotiator for Romania, Poul Thomsen, who made an analysis of the country's economy last week, said annual inflation this year would probably be 45 to 50 percent against a 20 percent target agreed under a standby arrangement with the International Monetary Fund.

The IMF suspended a three-year $460 million standby credit earlier this year, expressing discontent with upsets in the foreign exchange market and overspending by the former leftist government in an election year.
